name: Lyft
title: Lyft carried 22% of NYC trips in Sep 2026

subtitles.share_trend: Lyft's share of NYC trips fell 0.3 pts between Sep 2025 and Sep 2026
subtitles.fpm_dist: The median Lyft fare per mile rose 5.9% between Sep 2025 and Sep 2026, to $7.00/mile; most trips paid $4.04/mile to $12.55/mile (10th to 90th percentile)
subtitles.tip_rate: Lyft riders tipped 5.5% of the base fare in Sep 2026 (+0.5 pts on a year earlier)
subtitles.wav: Lyft completed 25,000 trips that requested a wheelchair-accessible vehicle in Sep 2026, and 7.2% of all its trips ran in one; requests that went unfilled aren't in TLC's records
subtitles.shared: Lyft riders made 2,860 shared-ride requests in Sep 2026, and 3.1% were matched
subtitles.compare: The median Lyft fare per mile, $7.00/mile in Sep 2026, was the second highest of 4 companies
subtitles.lyft_vs_uber: Lyft had a bigger share of pickups than Uber in 1 zone in Sep 2026, the same as a year earlier
